paths.description: Public OIDC sign-in surface, the mandatory entry path for EasyTrader.
Password recovery archetype linked from sign-in.
Primary trading dashboard and transaction journey; not covered because credentials and funded account state were unavailable.

findings.summary: The sign-in experience ignores the user’s dark-colour preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is pixel-identical to the light capture; the computed probe reports colorScheme "normal" and body background rgb(237, 240, 242) under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Keyboard access and focus treatment fail on security controls.
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports a transparent 2px outline and no box shadow. Three 28x28 DIV controls with onclick handlers have tabIndex -1 and no role or accessible name.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native buttons for password visibility and virtual-keyboard controls, provide accessible names, at least 44x44 hit areas, and a clearly visible :focus-visible treatment.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport because the page sets user-scalable=no; this prevents users with low vision from zooming.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and preserve reflow at 200% to 400% zoom.

findings.summary: The authentication entry is very slow to become useful.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 11.1s, LCP 15.6s and TBT 300ms (performance score 0.49); the CDP trace corroborates a 6.01s LCP and a 143ms long task.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the redirect/bootstrap critical path, prioritize the actual LCP, and defer nonessential scripts until after the login UI is usable.

findings.summary: Script, cache, and render-blocking costs are disproportionate for a login form.
findings.evidence: HAR records 2.98MB across 52 requests, including 2.63MB script; main-UZTPUCD5.js is 1.42MB with no cache header. Lighthouse estimates 209KiB unused JS and 82KiB unused CSS, and identifies parser-blocking classic scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the login route without booting the full trading bundle, split route code, defer classic scripts, remove duplicate analytics loads, compress text, and apply immutable caching to fingerprinted assets.

findings.summary: Analytics and cookie defaults expose more user data than necessary on a sensitive sign-in path.
findings.evidence: Trackers evidence finds Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics; HAR attributes 1.31MB and 28 requests to third parties. Cookie audit finds three cookies without Secure and SameSite=None, including two 400-day GA cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise analytics on authentication pages, eliminate duplicate tags, obtain appropriate consent, and set Secure plus an appropriate SameSite value on retained cookies.

findings.summary: Browser security policy is incomplete and the CSP permits unsafe script execution.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows a CSP containing unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval, while Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent. HSTS, nosniff and frame-ancestors are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsafe-eval, migrate inline scripts/styles to nonces or hashes, and add restrictive Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers.

findings.summary: The public authentication surface has weak crawler and sharing metadata.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no meta description. DOM/platform probes find no canonical, Open Graph metadata, JSON-LD, or heading; discoverability reports 0% word overlap and no raw title, while /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml both return the 15,897-byte app HTML rather than directives/XML.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve correct robots.txt and sitemap responses; add a description, canonical, semantic heading, and accurate sharing metadata to the public authentication landing surface.

findings.summary: Sign-in error feedback is not announced to assistive technology.
findings.evidence: After empty submit, Persian error text appears in spans, but the probe finds no role, aria-live, or aria-invalid on either invalid input.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark invalid fields with aria-invalid, connect messages via aria-describedby, and announce the error summary or field messages using an appropriate live region after submission.

findings.summary: The sign-in form disables password-manager and autofill support.
findings.evidence: The username input has no autocomplete token and the password field explicitly sets autocomplete="off".
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete="username" and autocomplete="current-password"; allow password managers and offer passkey sign-in where the identity system supports it.

findings.summary: The document lacks semantic heading structure.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe reports zero h1/h2/h3 elements, while the visual title “ورود به ایزی تریدر” is rendered with generic div/span markup.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark the page title as h1 and preserve a logical heading/landmark hierarchy across sign-in, registration, and password recovery.

findings.summary: The unauthenticated route does not progressively expose its purpose.
findings.evidence: Discoverability found 0% overlap, no title in raw HTML, and a crawler screenshot that differs from the rendered login. The raw entry requires JavaScript and redirects before exposing the login content.
findings.suggestedFix: Return meaningful server-rendered authentication content and links in the initial HTML, with enhancement for the OIDC flow rather than an opaque JS bootstrap.

findings.summary: Document and platform hygiene have avoidable defects.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports a deprecated unload listener and an unsized logo; the images primitive confirms both logos lack complete width/height dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unload listeners, use pagehide/visibilitychange where needed, and set both width and height (or aspect-ratio) on logos.

findings.summary: The page performs substantial nonessential background and third-party work.
findings.evidence: HAR records 31 script requests and 1.31MB third-party transfer for a small login form; duplicate GTM/gtag resources dominate several top transfer entries.
findings.suggestedFix: Load a single minimal analytics path only after it is justified, batch events, and avoid booting unrelated app code on the login route.

taskList.title: Strip the unauthenticated route to a fast, cached login payload
Restore native keyboard, focus, zoom, and semantic control accessibility
Harden analytics, cookies, CSP, and browser policies on authentication pages
Make sign-in validation and password-manager behavior humane
Serve meaningful crawler HTML and correct indexing files
Remove deprecated unload handling and size logo assets
